pr_title: Check explicitly for None value in Overkiz integration
pr_body:

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.

When migrating to the walrus operator we introduce a regression into the Overkiz component. When the cover position or the light brightness is 0, we don’t return the value, but None instead.

Tested on my own awning:

```
current_position: 0
device_class: awning
friendly_name: Store banne
supported_features: 15

```

issue_context.title: Overkiz covers not reporting current_position attribute.
issue_context.body:
### The problem

As Overkiz now is a core integration (on beta 2022.2.0b0) I replaced the custom_component with the core version.
However, some of my cover entities now don't have the attribute `current_position`

Entity attributes with custom_component:
```yaml
current_position: 0
device_class: awning
friendly_name: Pepijn
supported_features: 15
```

Entity attributes with core integration:
```yaml
device_class: awning
friendly_name: Pepijn
supported_features: 15
```

I have different cover tyes:
Working:
- Hardware: io:VerticalExteriorAwningIOComponent

Not Working:
- Hardware: io:HorizontalAwningIOComponent
- Hardware: io:AwningValanceIOComponent

Here is a zip with diagnostics info for all covers
[covers.zip](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/7949625/covers.zip)



### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.2.0b0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

N/A

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Overkiz
